text: OOMOL Connector 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的连接器插件，可通过 MCP 发现并调用 OOMOL Actions。它将 Connector 接入 DSH 工具系统，并在会话侧栏提供连接管理界面。用户可以搜索 Provider、查看认证方式、连接或重连账户、选择默认账户，并按授权选项管理权限。适合希望让 DSH 使用外部应用 Actions 的用户。Hosted 模式需要 OOMOL MCP API Key；也可配置自托管 OpenConnector。

OOMOL Connector integrates OOMOL Actions with DSH Web through MCP discovery and tool calls. Its session sidebar lets users search Providers, connect app accounts, choose a default account, and review authorization options. Hosted mode needs an OOMOL MCP API key; self-hosted is supported.

OOMOL Connector 的功能「发现 Actions」：通过 Streamable HTTP MCP 将 Connector 接入 DSH 工具客户端，以发现并调用 Actions；可配置 endpoint、命名空间和超时。
OOMOL Connector 的功能「管理应用连接」：会话右侧栏展示 Provider 与已连接账户，支持搜索、连接、重连、断开和设置默认账户；Hosted 模式由插件界面管理，自托管模式跳转 Console。
OOMOL Connector 的功能「选择授权选项」：连接 OAuth Provider 时读取授权选项和当前 scopes，允许用户选择权限，并自动纳入必选项及其依赖项后发起连接。
OOMOL Connector 的功能「多账户状态与默认账户」：界面识别连接、待处理和未连接状态，筛选可管理账户，并支持用户选择默认连接，供后续应用操作使用。
OOMOL Connector 的功能「配置与测试连接」：插件设置页显示连接状态，允许保存或移除凭据、测试 Connector 连接，并在凭据更新后刷新 MCP 客户端。
OOMOL Connector 使用前须知：Hosted 模式需要 OOMOL MCP API Key，可存入 Harness Credentials 或由 OOMOL_MCP_API_KEY 环境变量提供。
OOMOL Connector 使用前须知：插件默认连接 connector.oomol.com 的 MCP endpoint；自托管连接需自行设置 endpoint，Hosted 的内嵌连接管理不支持自托管模式。

dsh-oomol README · OOMOL Connector for DeepSeek Harness：Use OOMOL Connector Actions from DeepSeek Harness through progressive MCP discovery.

`dsh-oomol` supports OOMOL Hosted and self-hosted OpenConnector. One plugin instance connects to one Connector endpoint.

[npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-oomol) | [中文文档](./docs/README.zh-CN.md)

dsh-oomol README · Requirements：- Node.js 22.19 or later within Node.js 22, or Node.js 24+
- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` through 0.2.1 (0.2.1 starts at `0.2.1-rc.1`, its alphas are not supported)
- An OOMOL account for OOMOL Hosted, or a running OpenConnector instance for self-hosted use

dsh-oomol README · Install：Install the plugin into the Web profile and restart Harness:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add -w dsh-oomol
dsh web
```

The plugin appears on the **Plugins** page as `dsh-oomol`. Open it to configure the Connector key.

dsh-oomol README · OOMOL Hosted：The package connects to OOMOL Hosted by default:

```yaml
- id: oomol
  name: dsh-oomol
  config:
    endpoint: https://connector.oomol.com/v1/mcp

Create an OOMOL MCP API key in [OOMOL Console](https://console.oomol.com/api-key), then save it on the plugin page. Harness Credentials stores the key under `OOMOL_MCP_API_KEY`.

Managed environments can provide it at launch:

```bash
export OOMOL_MCP_API_KEY="api_..."
dsh web
```

Set a team identity when needed:

dsh-oomol README · OOMOL Hosted：```bash
export OOMOL_TEAM_NAME="your-team"
dsh web
```

The Connections button opens the native Harness panel for OOMOL Hosted accounts.

dsh-oomol README · Self-hosted OpenConnector：Override the endpoint in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- update:
    id: oomol
    config:
      endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:3000/mcp

The plugin recognizes every non-official endpoint as self-hosted. Local OpenConnector deployments can run without authentication. Deployments with runtime authentication use the key stored under `OOMOL_CONNECT_RUNTIME_TOKEN`:

```bash
export OOMOL_CONNECT_RUNTIME_TOKEN="oct_..."
dsh web
```

dsh-oomol README · Self-hosted OpenConnector：You can also save the runtime API key on the plugin page. Create persistent runtime keys in the OpenConnector Console Access page.

Self-hosted HTTP endpoints are limited to `localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, and `[::1]`. Remote deployments use HTTPS:

```yaml
- update:
    id: oomol
    config:
      endpoint: https://connect.example.com/mcp

The Connections button opens the endpoint origin, such as `https://connect.example.com`, where OpenConnector serves its Console.

dsh-oomol README · Custom API key environment name：Both modes support an explicit credential reference:

```yaml
- update:
    id: oomol
    config:
      endpoint: https://connect.example.com/mcp

Harness Credentials resolves `apiKeyEnv` first and the launch environment second.

dsh-oomol README · Use Connector Actions：Start with discovery:

```text
Show me the connectors available to this account.
```

```text
Find Actions that can create a calendar event and inspect the selected Action schema.
```

For operations with external effects, include the target account and proposed arguments in your request before execution.

dsh-oomol README · How it works：The plugin mounts DeepSeek Harness's Streamable HTTP MCP client with the selected Connector endpoint. Connector Actions remain progressively discoverable, keeping the permanent Harness tool surface small.

OOMOL Hosted stores Provider credentials in OOMOL Connector. Self-hosted deployments store them in OpenConnector. Harness stores only the Connector client key selected by `apiKeyEnv`.

dsh-oomol README · How it works：The browser receives the credential reference and status metadata. Connector API keys and Provider credentials stay in Host-side secret boundaries.

See [Architecture](./docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) for implementation details.

dsh-oomol README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `endpoint` | `https://connector.oomol.com/v1/mcp` | Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint |
| `apiKeyEnv` | Derived from `endpoint` | Harness credential reference and launch environment name |
| `teamName` | unset | OOMOL Hosted team identity |
| `teamNameEnv` | `OOMOL_TEAM_NAME` | OOMOL Hosted team environment name |
| `serverName` | `oomol` | Harness MCP tool namespace |
| `toolCallTimeoutMs` | `60000` | Tool call timeout |
| `failOnStartupError` | `false` | Fail Harness startup when MCP discovery fails |

dsh-oomol README · Configuration：Derived credential references:

| Endpoint mode | Default reference | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| OOMOL Hosted | `OOMOL_MCP_API_KEY` | Yes |
| Self-hosted | `OOMOL_CONNECT_RUNTIME_TOKEN` | Depends on the OpenConnector deployment |

dsh-oomol README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Plugin missing from the Plugins page | Install it in the `web` profile and restart `dsh web` |
| OOMOL Hosted shows Not configured | Save an OOMOL MCP API key on the plugin page |
| Self-hosted returns Unauthorized | Save a runtime API key created by that OpenConnector instance |
| Self-hosted Console link returns 404 | Open the Console URL configured by the OpenConnector deployment |
| Expected app is missing | Open the relevant Connector Console and configure the Provider connection |
| Connections tab does not appear | Open a Session first; the Connections tab lives in that Session's right sidebar |

dsh-oomol README · Troubleshooting：Run local diagnostics:

```bash
pnpm run doctor
```

dsh-oomol README · Security：- Store Connector API keys in Harness Credentials or the launch environment.
- Use HTTPS for remote self-hosted endpoints.
- Review destructive, externally visible, permission-changing, and broad-sharing Actions before execution.
- Treat an ambiguous side-effecting call as an unknown outcome and inspect the Provider before retrying.
- Report vulnerabilities through [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md).

dsh-oomol README · Development：```bash
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm check
```

Build and install the checkout into a Web profile:

```bash
pnpm build
dsh plugin --profile web add -w "$(pwd)"
```
